description: Audit and repair authentication and authorization integration across all existing endpoints without redesigning the existing auth system

selected_catalog_items.routes_in_scope: ALL registered API routes across all routers
selected_catalog_items.source_row: Prompt specification, not from Excel catalog

assumptions: All endpoints not explicitly marked public should be protected following the existing require_role pattern
Read/list endpoints require operator role minimum
Create/update/delete/write endpoints require admin role minimum
Health, login, token, refresh, dashboard page, and static media remain public
WebSocket endpoints remain unprotected due to Bearer token transport limitations
MJPEG streams and snapshot endpoints remain unprotected as they serve the public dashboard
